note: The savannah rims' adapter onto the material library (core/materials/PLAN.md; biomes/hyperjungle/PLAN-LANDS.md section 10). Keys are the kit's slots (src/50 SAVRIM.MAT, the ground in 45, the mounds in 87). grass: the red oat grass on one plant of card.grass.dry (as eastabyss and swbay take it); blind: the blind grass on card.rankgrass, a stand-in until card.grass.elephant (PROMPTS-NEEDED.md section 37); fan: the fan palm's fronds on card.palm (base bottom); palmbark: its trunk; termite: the termite cathedrals (KSTACKS' uv in metres); groundDetail: the savannah's litter as KGROUND's detail layer. Run python3 tools/textures/pack.py biomes/savannarim after any change, then python3 build.py (and --station east, --station north).
